# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 21 Aug 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## Private Residential Market

- **New home sales rebound to 3-month high in July 2026** - Developers sold 731 new private homes (excluding ECs) in July 2026, up 368.6% from the 156 units sold in June, marking the strongest sales month since April. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/new-home-sales-rebound-to-3-month-high-as-july-launches-return/)

- **Up to 2,550 private homes could come to Kallang Distripark** - URA published proposed Master Plan amendments on 14 August 2026 that would redevelop the existing Kallang Distripark industrial site into a private housing precinct of potentially more than 2,000 homes near Geylang Bahru MRT station. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/kallang-distripark-redevelopment-private-homes/)

- **Condo rental prices and volumes hit all-time highs in July 2026** - Singapore's condo rental market reached two milestones in July 2026, with both rental prices and transaction volumes climbing to their highest levels on record, while the HDB rental market also strengthened. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-rental-prices-volumes-record-high-july-2026/)

## HDB Resale Records

- **14-year-old Bishan 4-room flat sells for record $1.3 million** - A 4-room flat at 273A Bishan Street 24 (Natura Loft) sold for $1.3 million in August 2026, setting a new Bishan record and beating the previous high in the same block by $37,000. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/14-year-old-bishan-4-room-flat-sold-for-record-1-3m/)

- **Clementi Peaks 3-room flat breaks town resale record at S$896K** - A unit at Clementi Peaks sold for S$896,000 — a new 3-room HDB resale record for Clementi — and was transacted even before the development reached its Minimum Occupation Period (MOP). [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/clementi-peaks-first-resale-breaks-3rm-hdb-record-at-s896k/)
